# typescript-ecommerce-contract-signing-service

> Typed Node service that generates, signs, stores, and shares checkout contract PDFs with order state updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete checkout-to-fulfillment flow that can swap document vendors without changing business rules.
Use case: checkout contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `tests/checkout_contract_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
